desc.cn: 蟠兽顽皮，在各处留下了痕迹，虽然爪印十分可爱，但污渍也是实打实的，还是快快清理干净吧！
desc.en: A naughty pantailbeast has left plenty of stains. The tiny paw prints are cute but the stains are very real as well. In any case, we should clean them up ASAP!

name.cn: 小兽留痕

desc.cn: 实际上，驮兽十分聪明，尤其是学生们饲养的驮兽。我们有理由怀疑，它们弄脏自己就是为了爽快地洗一个冷水澡。
desc.en: Burdenbeasts are actually quite smart, especially those raised by Tianshi disciples. We suspect they get themselves dirty on purpose just to get a proper hose-down.

name.cn: 冷水澡

desc.cn: 高墙上的污痕着实令人压抑，在影响到大家的心情前，请将它清理干净吧。
desc.en: The stains on the high walls look very depressing. Clean them up before anyone gets affected.

name.cn: 污云压城

desc.cn: 荣誉天师，城市形象大使，环带吉祥物大赛冠军必须时时刻刻清清爽爽！
desc.en: The Honorary Tianshi, mascot of Wuling City, and ultimate winner of the Band Mascot Championships must be sparkling clean at all times!

name.cn: 拯救龙泡泡

desc.cn: 并非只有直观可见的污渍才需清理，不可见的顽垢亦是隐患。
desc.en: Visible stains must be cleaned. Invisible stains are hidden risks and should be rinsed as well.

name.cn: 不可见隐患

desc.cn: 您高速冲洗各类污渍的事迹已在武陵环卫职工之间广泛传播，他们期待一场完美的清污演练。
desc.en: All the urban sanitation workers in Wuling are talking about your impressive high-speed cleaning feats. They are looking forward to your perfect performance in the cleaning drill.

name.cn: 平台清污演练

desc.cn: 武陵良好市容的基础在于环卫职工们每一日反反复复地清洁打扫，如今您的奉献成为了这基础的一部分。
desc.en: The daily toil of the urban sanitation workers forms the foundation of Wuling's pristine urban garden. Your contribution adds a brick to that foundation.

name.cn: 弹性清洁演练

desc.cn: “第一课！物以类聚，人以群分，兽……呃……虫……呃……总之有共性的生物往往会聚集在一处……”
desc.en: "LESSON ONE! Like draws like! People naturally settle into tribes! While beasts and bugs ... into ... uhm... Whatever! Critters that look the same tend to gather..."

name.cn: 物以类聚

desc.cn: “第二课！当‘野兽’视你为敌人，请您必须严肃待之！最大火力，不要手下留情！”
desc.en: "LESSON TWO! If the 'wild things' treat you as an enemy, deal with it seriously! MAX the firepower! No mercy!"

name.cn: 爆破练习

desc.cn: “第三课！巧妙利用大自然的残酷，无论生命还是死亡，起始与终结都可以利用。”
desc.en: "LESSON THREE! Leverage nature's fickle cruelty! Life and death! The beginning and the end! Everything can be used!"

name.cn: 虫海求生

desc.cn: “第四课！取舍。大自然向您展示的信息是复杂的，您需要取舍，请高效安排处理事务的顺序。”
desc.en: "LESSON FOUR! Prioritize! Nature shows you a huge mess of info. You gotta choose what to engage in and prioritize task sequences."

name.cn: 多向爆破

desc.cn: “第五课！观察。无论是扎营，还是狩猎，选好您的目标，当然，也要选好您的邻居。”
desc.en: "LESSON FIVE! Observe! Select a proper target when camping or hunting. And pitch your tent next to proper neighbors."

name.cn: 恶邻

desc.cn: “第六课！宣称。向眼前的一切，宣告您的领地范围，消灭入侵者！”
desc.en: "LESSON SIX! Declaration! Announce your territories to everything! And yes, neutralize the intruders!"

name.cn: 城堡准则

desc.cn: “第七课！自视。请在之前学到的野性知识中，回忆起您人类的身份，分析这头凶暴野兽的弱点，击败它！”
desc.en: "LESSON SEVEN! Self-awareness! I know you took plenty of wilderness knowledge courses, but remember that you're a bipedal sapient! Analyze the weak points of this feral critter and defeat it!"

name.cn: 野性苦果

desc.cn: “那么，最终考核现在开始，请您尽力而为。”
desc.en: "Well, the final assessment is starting now. Do not push yourself too hard."

name.cn: 最终考核
